polyfills.note: 1.17.2 removed record_frame_timing and added record_frame_event in the same profiler rewrite (FrameEvent machinery). Confirmed 2026-09-06 by the gocar maintainers as the mechanical successor for the T-14 v1 demo — the call shape is the same record-a-sample call. T-26 (2026-09-07): the keys are re-based onto the v2 qualified identity (`fn:profiler::…`); the measured successor is cfg-gated (`cfg(feature = "profiler")`) at 1.17.2+, so the migration engine refuses this rename at those targets unless the target build enables the feature — re-verify payload semantics (the payload is now FrameEvent::Draw(FrameTiming)) and the feature before relying on this rule.
